context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin review management feature implemented. Backend endpoints: GET /api/admin/reviews (fetch all), POST /api/admin/reviews/{id}/reply (add/edit reply), DELETE /api/admin/reviews/{id}. All require admin authentication. Frontend: AdminDashboard.js has Reviews tab with reply/edit/delete functionality. Review model includes admin_reply and admin_reply_at fields. Public reviews show admin replies with 'Response from DECODE MATHS:' styling. Landing page testimonials show 'DECODE MATHS replied:' styling.
